subject: skill/stack/celery-redis
claim: Make Celery tasks idempotent: by default a worker acknowledges the message before executing, but with acks_late=True a crashed worker redelivers, so side effects must be safe to repeat. Retry transient work with autoretry_for plus retry_backoff=True (exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 10 minutes by default) instead of hand-rolled try/except; keep max_retries bounded (default 3). Give every task a unique namespaced name and route long-running work to dedicated queues.
notes: Tasks backs message-acknowledgement ordering, idempotency, acks_late, autoretry_for/retry_backoff/retry_jitter/retry_backoff_max defaults, max_retries and task naming. Calling backs apply_async execution options, queue routing/priority and the deliberately short default publish-retry policy (max 3). Both agree; low uncertainty.
